entities.summary: Tuồng cải lương often referred to as Cải lương, roughly "reformed theater") is a form of modern folk opera in Vietnam. It blends southern Vietnamese folk songs, classical music, hát tuồng, and modern spoken drama. cải lương is a music genre. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
